universalEditor.title: Universal Editor
universalEditor.description: Visually edit your site content inline, directly on the rendered page.
universalEditor.noInlineEditing: This page's editor bridge does not support editing in place; use the properties panel.
universalEditor.sectionSelected: This section is selected. Click one of its fields to edit the text.
universalEditor.duplicateHint: Duplicate places the same section on the page twice — editing one of them edits both.
universalEditor.sectionsNotWritable: This page's sections cannot be reordered from here: it does not carry them in a 'sections' field of the length on screen.
universalEditor.sectionSaveError: Could not write the page's sections; reloading the preview
universalEditor.nothingFits: This page's template says nothing can be added here.
universalEditor.typeNotProvisioned: This page's template offers {{type}}, but this instance does not have that post type yet.
universalEditor.revertField: Put this field back to what it was before you started
universalEditor.discardConfirm: Discard {{count}} pending change(s) and put every field back?
universalEditor.leaveConfirm: You have {{count}} unsaved change(s). Leave the editor and lose them?
universalEditor.noSelectionDescription: Click on an element in the page to select it and edit its properties.
universalEditor.noSitesDescription: Create a site first in the Content section, then come back here to edit it visually.
universalEditor.urlHint: Open any page instrumented with data-sh-* attributes for visual editing.
universalEditor.siteNotFound: No site resolved for '{{key}}'. Pick one from the list.
universalEditor.bridgeAbsent: This page did not hand back the editor bridge.
universalEditor.bridgeAbsentHint: You can still see it, but nothing on it is editable. Either the page failed to load, or its front end does not support inline editing yet.
